title: Setting up a new enterprise
author: 637a4e2c89ac12120fbab5de
chapter_outcomes: Explain the six stages of the enterprise process: 1 identifying the problem or need or want, 2 exploring creative solutions, 3 action planning, 4 implementing the plan, 5 monitoring progress, 6 evaluation of successes and failures
Explain the different kinds of organisation, including: sole trader, partnership, limited company, co-operative, franchise, social enterprise: charities, not-for-profit organisations
Consider the legal status, advantages and disadvantages for each type for a new enterprise
